prompts.body: Heading to the beach? Tell me the 3 things you're looking forward to most.
prompts.subtext: Kick it off great... lots of detail!

prompts.body: Day 1 was lots of travel. What was the funniest thing that happened?
prompts.subtext: Bonus points if someone in the group looks silly

prompts.body: Tell me about something that happened today that was completely unexpected?
prompts.subtext: Accident? Surprise? Hope nobody got hurt!

prompts.body: Last day! What will you remember the most about this trip?
prompts.subtext: Did you see Sam the fish again? Or something else?
